title: (RHBA-2014:0971) rhevm-reports 3.4.1 bug fix update
portal_summary: An updated rhevm-reports package that fixes a bug is now available.
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously-released errata relevant
to your system have been applied.
portal_description:
The Red Hat Enterprise Virtualization reports package provides a suite of
pre-configured reports and dashboards that enable you to monitor the system. The
reports module is based on JasperReports and JasperServer, and can also be used
to create ad-hoc reports.

Changes to the rhevm-reports component:

* Previously, in some versions of JBoss, the Reports application failed to
deploy because 'Resteasy' was attempting, and failing, to activate Resteasy
integration support. This happened because the Reports application includes its
own conflicting version of Resteasy. Now, a workaround that disables this
integration allows the Reports application to start. (BZ#1117190)

* 'war' file is now deleted from the file system after a clean install of
reports fails in engine setup. (BZ#1112305)

All Red Hat Enterprise Virtualization reports and data warehouse users are
advised to upgrade to this updated package which addresses these issues.
